recentItems.title: LIVE: Metro Manila traffic situation and updates (Afternoon Rush Hour) | September 4, 2026
recentItems.description:
Stay informed before heading out on the road! Here is the latest real-time vehicular flow and road advisories across major thoroughfares in the National Capital Region (NCR).

This broadcast delivers live traffic updates for commuters, motorists, and transport operators navigating critical transit corridors across Metro Manila, including EDSA, C-5 Road, Quezon Avenue, Commonwealth Avenue, Roxas Boulevard, Taft Avenue, and key expressways.

MMDA Unified Vehicular Volume Reduction Program (UVVRP) / Number Coding Scheme:
· Standard Hours: 7:00 AM – 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Monday to Friday, excluding holidays).
· Standard Window Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Note: Window hours apply on most major roads; Makati City enforces no-window coding).

Daily License Plate Ending Schedule:
· Mondays: 1 & 2
· Tuesdays: 3 & 4
· Wednesdays: 5 & 6
· Thursdays: 7 & 8
· Fridays: 9 & 0

Emergency & Assistance Hotlines:
· MMDA Hotline: 136
· MMDA Metrobase: (02) 8882-4151 to 77

recentItems.title: VP Sara camp says she will face grave threats case
recentItems.description:
Top Story: The Quezon City court issued an arrest order against Vice President Sara Duterte in connection with the grave threats case and set bail at P120,000 for each count. Duterte’s lawyer said the vice president had no intention of evading the law and would exercise all legal remedies, including on the issue of jurisdiction.
